tidbit: Did you know… about 13,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Anthropic files for an IPO, Confirmed by The Defiant, reporting $16.3 billion in first-half revenue and a $1.9 trillion pre-IPO valuation.
Elvis music rights owners are suing Anthropic over copyright violations, Confirmed by BBC, claiming 274 songs were used to train Claude.
Bessemer Venture Partners calls its Anthropic investment the largest in the firm's 116-year history, Confirmed by CNBC, underscoring the company's scale.
Anthropic could debut at a staggering $2 trillion valuation, Reported by Ynetnews, with the company filing for its public offering after reporting $16.3 billion revenue and $80.7 billion loss in the first half of 2026.
Anthropic's S-1 filing reveals details of the IPO, Confirmed by CNBC, as Bessemer reaffirms this is its largest investment across 116 years.
Free every hour.
